selection: row-major grid; floor((i+0.5)*32/grid_size); content-independent; gather before cross-image bmm
mutual_matching: same argmax/no-match rule, reverse candidates restricted to selected queries; no hidden dense reverse correlation
precision: BF16 autocast as T03; unchanged FP32 logits and existing geometry
subset_selection: before predictions: 8 input-only brightness/contrast strata; deterministic seed; distinct verified 512 parents for timing; no asserted satellite scene identities

timing.primary: no-hook prediction, coordinate transfer and affine RANSAC; GPU inputs resident, excludes I/O and host-to-device
timing.stages: separate calls with synchronization; not summed to claim overall latency

teacher.prediction_zero: counts as wrong on valid ground truth; never erase predicted Ignore to improve scores
